author: ladiosupp
name: Profile Recorder
description: Records full-point curves (machine telemetry + RAW scale + state events) for every espresso shot that HyperEx Pulse Filter does NOT record. Shots whose profile title does not start with the fixed HyperEx prefix are kept immediately (HyperEx never records them). HyperEx-titled shots are matched against HyperEx diagnostic summary (start contained in the espresso window, end within 10s) and dropped on match, so sources never overlap. Keeps the newest 4 full records (new overwrites old) and serves them at /history-export in the same shape as HyperEx export, so ProfileReplayer merges both sources with runId dedup. Read-only: never writes machine state, profiles or settings.

Enabled.label: Enable recording
Enabled.description: Record non-HyperEx espresso shots. Disable to stop capture; stored records remain available at /history-export.

SampleIntervalMs.label: Sample interval (ms)
SampleIntervalMs.description: Target cadence for combined machine/scale samples, same role as HyperEx DiagnosticSampleIntervalMs. Clamped 50-1000; 100 recommended.
